info.name: Shear Heaven API (2026)
info.description:
Unified auth: POST /api/auth/login with role (customer | groomer | staff). Staff kinds: platform_admin, store_admin, store_staff.

User management: platform → /api/common/user-management/*; store portal → /api/common/store-access/*.

Appointment milestones:
- Store config (staff): GET/PUT/DELETE /api/common/appointment-milestones?ClientID&RegionId&StoreId
- Groomer catalog: GET /api/common/groomer/appointment-milestones
- Per booking: GET .../milestones?storeId= ; POST .../milestone with milestoneKey + milestoneDateTime
- Skip bath/grooming: POST .../milestone ready_for_checkout with payload.skipMilestones=true (after check-in)
- Normal checkout path: grooming_completed then ready_for_checkout without skipMilestones

Groomer: Bearer {{groomerAccessToken}} → /api/common/groomer/*
Staff: {{adminAccessToken}} | {{storeAdminAccessToken}} | {{storeStaffAccessToken}} → /api/common/*
Customer: Bearer {{accessToken}} → /api/bookings

Tenant: headers ClientId, RegionId, StoreId; store lists also accept query ClientID, RegionId, StoreId.

Service catalog (store):
- Pet size categories: GET/PUT /api/common/pet-size-prices?ClientID&RegionId&StoreId
- Service master: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/common/service-master (pet size tiers + milestoneKeyCompleted/Skipped)
- Package master: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/common/package-master (serviceIds → booking milestone lines)
- Customer catalog: GET /api/service-packages (mirrors master after publish)

Service progress (live booking_progress socket):
- Groomer: PUT /api/common/groomer/bookings/:id/service-progress ; POST .../skip
- Staff: PUT /api/common/bookings/:bookingId/service-progress ; POST .../skip
- Response includes serviceProgress[] with taskKey, skipAllowed, durationMinutes

item.name: User management & store access
item.description: Platform admin: /api/common/user-management/* (catalog CRUD, roles, store-staff). Store admin/staff: /api/common/store-access/*. Tenant: query ClientID, RegionId, StoreId and/or headers ClientId, RegionId, StoreId.
